events.verdict: Sexton (CHI) legally contests Bal's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Okoro (CHI) establishes a screening position outside of Coward's (MEM) field of view and gives him a step to avoid the contact.
Clayton Jr. (MEM) is moving alongside Giddey's (CHI) path and marginal contact occurs as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Jones (CHI) and Coward (MEM) come together at the same spot in the post, and the body to body contact that occurs is marginal.
Bal (MEM) brings his arm toward Giddey's (CHI) path and marginal contact occurs during Giddey's (CHI) drive.
Clayton Jr. (MEM) makes contact with the ball that dislodges it away from Giddey (CHI) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests Mashack's (MEM) layup attempt.
Bal (MEM) brushes Jones' (CHI) shoulder and marginal contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Coward (MEM) extends his left arm and initiates contact with Sexton (CHI) that dislodges him from his legally obtained defensive position off-ball.
Okoro (CHI) brings his hands towards Bal (MEM) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is incidental.
Rupert (MEM) brushes Jones' (CHI) arm and marginal contact occurs during Jones' (CHI) driving shot attempt.
Giddey (CHI) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests Clayton Jr.'s (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Rupert (MEM) is moving alongside Jones' (CHI) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.
Sexton (CHI) swipes down and initiates illegal contact with Coward's (MEM) arm.
Rupert (MEM) commits a take foul on Giddey (CHI).
The crew communicated with Replay Center Official, Robert Hussey, who confirmed the on-court ruling of no basket. Sexton (CHI) does not release his shot attempt before the game clock expires.
